H1514.name: Gaham
H1514.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1514.short: Gaham was one of the sons born to Nahor, Abraham's brother, and his concubine Reumah.

H1515.name: Gahar
H1515.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1515.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
H1515.short: Gahar was an ancestor of a group of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H1559G.name: Galal
H1559G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H1559G.brief: Levite musician; descendant of Asaph; lived in Jerusalem.
H1559G.short: Galal, a Levite musician and descendant of Asaph, lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H1559H.name: Galal
H1559H.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H1559H.brief: Levite musician; descendant of Jeduthun; lived in Jerusalem.
H1559H.short: Galal, a Levite musician and descendant of Jeduthun, lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile and assisted in the temple service.

H1583.name: Gamaliel
H1583.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1583.brief: Leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the Exodus.
H1583.short: Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, was the leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

H1577.name: Gamul
H1577.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1577.brief: Head of a priestly division in David's time.
H1577.short: Gamul was the head of the twenty-second priestly division organized during King David's reign.

H1502.name: Gazzam
H1502.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1502.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
H1502.short: Gazzam was an ancestor of a group of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

H1522.name: Gehazi
H1522.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1522.brief: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.
H1522.short: Gehazi, the servant of the prophet Elisha, was punished with leprosy for his greed and deceit in the matter of Naaman's healing.

H1582.name: Gemalli
H1582.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1582.brief: Father of Ammiel, the spy from the tribe of Dan.
H1582.short: Gemalli was the father of Ammiel, who represented the tribe of Dan as one of the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

H1587G.name: Gemariah
H1587G.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1587G.brief: Son of Hilkiah; messenger sent by Zedekiah to Nebuchadnezzar.
H1587G.short: Gemariah, the son of Hilkiah, was a messenger sent by King Zedekiah of Judah to deliver a letter to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

H1587H.name: Gemariah
H1587H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1587H.brief: Son of Shaphan; official during Jehoiakim's reign; opposed burning scroll.
H1587H.short: Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, was an official during King Jehoiakim's reign who opposed the burning of Jeremiah's scroll.

H1592.name: Genubath
H1592.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H1592.brief: Son of Hadad the Edomite; raised in Pharaoh's palace.
H1592.short: Genubath was the son of Hadad the Edomite and was raised in Pharaoh's palace alongside the Pharaoh's own children.

H1529.name: Geshan
H1529.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1529.brief: Son of Jahdai, a descendant of Caleb.
H1529.short: Geshan was a son of Jahdai, a wife of Caleb, from the tribe of Judah.

H1562.name: Gilalai
H1562.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1562.brief: Priest and musician during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H1562.short: Gilalai was a priest and musician who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H1568J.name: Gilead
H1568J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1568J.brief: Descendant of Manasseh; son of Michael; father of Jaroah.
H1568J.short: Gilead, a descendant of Manasseh, was the son of Michael and the father of Jaroah, as recorded in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad.

H1568I.name: Gilead
H1568I.brief: Father of Jephthah, a judge of Israel.
H1568I.short: Gilead was the father of Jephthah, a mighty warrior and judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the Ammonites.

H1568H.name: Gilead
H1568H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H1568H.brief: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.
H1568H.short: Gilead was the son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh, and father of six sons who became the heads of Gileadite clans.

H1527.name: Ginath
H1527.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1527.brief: Father of Tibni, who opposed Omri for kingship.
H1527.short: Ginath was the father of Tibni, who contended with Omri for the throne of Israel.

H1599.name: Ginnethon
H1599.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H1599.brief: A priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.
H1599.short: Ginnethon, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's reforms.

H1511.name: Girzites
H1511.brief: A people group David raided while living among the Philistines.
H1511.short: The Girzites were a people group David raided during his time living in Philistine territory.

H1555.name: Goliath
H1555.desc: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
H1555.brief: A Philistine giant defeated by David.
H1555.short: Goliath was the Philistine champion from Gath who was defeated by David in a battle.

H1586G.name: Gomer
H1586G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H1586G.brief: Son of Japheth; father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
H1586G.short: Gomer, a son of Japheth, was the father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah, as listed in the Table of Nations.

H1586H.name: Gomer
H1586H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H1586H.short: Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, was the wife of the prophet Hosea.

H1551.name: Galilee
H1551.brief: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry
H1551.short: Galilee, a region in northern Israel, was a significant location in Jesus' life and ministry, as well as the homeland of many of his disciples.

H1554.name: Gallim
H1554.brief: Town in Benjamin; home of Michal's husband Paltiel
H1554.short: Gallim, a town in Benjamin, was the home of Paltiel, Michal's husband, and is mentioned in a prophecy of Isaiah.

H1575.name: Gamad
H1575.brief: People group; defenders of the towers of Tyre
H1575.short: The Gamad were a people group mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy as defenders of the towers of Tyre.

H1507.name: Gezer
H1507.brief: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

H1520.name: Giah
H1520.brief: Location near Gibeon where Joab and Abishai pursued Abner.
H1520.short: Giah was a place near Gibeon where Joab and Abishai pursued Abner after the battle at the pool of Gibeon.

H1521.name: Gihon
H1521.brief: A river of Eden; a spring near Jerusalem.
H1521.short: Gihon refers to both a river of Eden (<ref="Genesis 2:13">Genesis 2:13</ref>) and a spring near Jerusalem (<ref="1Ki.1.33, 38, 45; 2Ch.32.30; 33:14">1Ki.1.33, 38, 45; 2Ch.32.30; 33:14</ref>).

H1533G.name: Gilboa
H1533G.brief: A mountain range where Saul and his sons died.
H1533G.short: Mount Gilboa was the site of a battle where Saul and his sons were killed by the Philistines (<ref="1Sa.28.4; 2Sa.1.21; 21:12">1Sa.28.4; 2Sa.1.21; 21:12</ref>).

H1533H.name: Gilboa Mount
H1533H.brief: A mountain range where Saul and his sons died.
H1533H.short: Mount Gilboa was the site where Saul and his sons were killed in battle against the Philistines (<ref="1Sa.31.1, 8; 2Sa.1.6; 1Ch.10.1, 8; Judges 7:3">1Sa.31.1, 8; 2Sa.1.6; 1Ch.10.1, 8; Judges 7:3</ref>).

H1568G.name: Gilead
H1568G.brief: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.
H1568G.short: Gilead refers to a mountainous region east of the Jordan River, as well as being a personal name for several individuals in the Old Testament.

H1537H.name: Gilgal
H1537H.brief: A place associated with the prophets Elijah and Elisha.
H1537H.short: Gilgal, a place associated with the prophets Elijah and Elisha, was the starting point of Elijah's final journey and the location of a prophetic community (<ref="2Ki.2.1; 4:38">2Ki.2.1; 4:38</ref>).

H1537G.name: Gilgal
H1537G.brief: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.
H1537G.short: Gilgal, also known as Geliloth, Beth-gilgal, or Gibeath-haaraloth, was a significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan, serving as a base for Joshua and a place of worship (<ref="Deu.11.30; Joshua 4:19-20; 5:3,9-10; 14:6; Judges 2:1; 11:14-15; 15:12-33; Hosea 9:15">Deu.11.30; Joshua 4:19-20; 5:3,9-10; 14:6; Judges 2:1; 11:14-15; 15:12-33; Hosea 9:15</ref>).

H1542.name: Giloh
H1542.brief: A city in Judah; home of Ahithophel, David's counselor.
H1542.short: Giloh, also known as Gilo, was a city in Judah and the hometown of Ahithophel, David's counselor who later conspired with Absalom (<ref="Joshua 15:51; 2Sa.15.12; 23:34">Joshua 15:51; 2Sa.15.12; 23:34</ref>).

H1579.name: Gimzo
H1579.brief: A city in Judah captured by the Philistines.
H1579.short: Gimzo was a city in the plain of Judah that was captured by the Philistines during the reign of Ahaz (<ref="2Ch.28.18">2Ch.28.18</ref>).

H1516O.name: Travelers Valley
H1516O.brief: A valley where Gog's army will be buried
H1516O.short: The Valley of the Travelers, a location where the army of Gog will be buried after their defeat, blocking the path of travelers (<ref="Ezek. 39:11">Ezek. 39:11</ref>).

H1588G.name: Uzza
H1588G.brief: A garden where Manasseh and Amon were buried
H1588G.short: Uzza, a garden in Jerusalem where Manasseh and his son Amon, kings of Judah, were buried (<ref="2Kgs. 21:18, 26">2Kgs. 21:18, 26</ref>).

H1516M.name: Valley Gate
H1516M.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
H1516M.short: The Valley Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in connection with King Uzziah's fortifications (<ref="2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13">2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13</ref>).
